_note: Ground-truth labels for the triage agent. Kept separate from the fixtures so the agent never sees the answers. 'why' is the reasoning a human reviewer agreed on, used by the LLM judge as a reference.

cases.why: Connection refused to staging, 41 tests failed in the same run, no recent changes: the environment was down.
Playwright was upgraded by dependabot but browsers were not reinstalled on the runner; tooling, not app or test.
Navigation timeout with 44 failures in the same run and no changes: staging was unreachable or overloaded.
An approved SSO button made the 'Sign in' locator ambiguous; the locator needs to be exact, the app is correct.
Intermittent 4/10 failures and a hard waitForTimeout before a non-retrying check: classic flaky test.
The button was renamed 'Sign in' in an approved change; the test still expects 'Login' and is outdated.
The error now names the field and the email, violating the requirement for a generic error (AC4); unapproved change.
After a counter refactor the button stays enabled after 3 failures: lockout requirement (AC5) is broken.
Looks like a timeout, but the button is disabled after only one earlier failure; the same counter refactor stopped resetting the counter. A real bug, not infra.
Fails only when parallel workers share one account after fullyParallel was enabled; test data isolation problem.
